article.headline: Games To Watch: Unbeaten South Pontotoc girls visit Hickory Flat; Starkville heads to Brandon
article.html:
South Pontotoc’s unbeaten girls basketball start gets a road test at Hickory Flat on Monday, November 16, leading a selected Mississippi varsity slate that also includes boys basketball and soccer. The Cougars enter at a listed 4-0 against a 3-2 host, while Starkville’s boys soccer team visits Brandon with a chance to move above an even record.

Girls basketball: South Pontotoc takes its perfect start on the road

The South Pontotoc–Hickory Flat girls game tips at 6 p.m. CST. Both teams bring winning records. South Pontotoc’s 4-0 opening meets Hickory Flat’s 3-2 start in a nonconference matchup, with the Rebels getting the home opportunity to hand the Cougars their first loss.

Boys basketball: contrasting starts at Hickory Flat and East Rankin

South Pontotoc’s boys follow with a 7:30 p.m. CST visit to Hickory Flat. The Cougars are listed at 2-2 and the Rebels at 1-4. The nonconference game offers South Pontotoc a chance to move to a winning record, while Hickory Flat can take a step toward closing its early deficit with a home victory.

At East Rankin Academy, Bayou Academy’s boys are scheduled for 7 p.m. CST. The Patriots bring a listed 3-1 record to their home floor in Pelahatchie; the visiting Colts are 0-1. East Rankin has the stronger opening record, but Bayou has only one reported game behind its mark. That difference in the available sample is useful context: the Colts are seeking their first listed win against a host trying to build on a winning start.

Boys soccer: Starkville and Brandon seek a step forward

The soccer selection is Starkville at Brandon at 7:15 p.m. CST. Starkville enters at a listed 3-3, with Brandon at 2-3-1. A road win would put the Yellowjackets above an even record; a home win would bring the Bulldogs level in wins and losses. It is a nonconference match, and readers can revisit Brandon’s recent soccer coverage in Saturday’s varsity recap.
